https://github.com/hobuinc/laz-perf/archive/b7bbe26109dc986f42d4fc80b8de3d2b6ca634ce.tar.gz
SHA-256:
17df34ca64cc60e107f0c214db4729c54a514df4e32de5bc1b8b7b7c5a805a56

SceneIO fetches that immutable archive at configure time and compiles only:
- cpp/lazperf/*.cpp
- cpp/lazperf/detail/*.cpp

Upstream's shared library, tools, examples, tests, benchmarks, install rules,
and downloaded test data are not configured.

Local correctness patch:
- cpp/lazperf/streams.hpp MemoryStream::getByte checks idx against buf.size()
  and throws lazperf::error on exhaustion before indexing. Upstream format-1.4
  decoders copy bounded layer bytes into this vector, so the check converts a
  corrupt arithmetic layer's over-read into the same clean codec error as an
  exhausted outer callback. CMake applies an exact idempotent replacement and
  fails if the pinned target changes.
- cpp/lazperf/decompressor.hpp performs full-range predictor addition with
  defined uint32 wrapping, computes bounded predictor/corrector arithmetic in
  int64 in both the normal and optional COMPRESS_ONLY_K decoder branches, and
  rejects a malformed k=31 corrector that cannot fit int32. The patch includes
  its own cstdint and limits headers. This preserves valid LASzip arithmetic
  while making corrupted layered streams raise lazperf::error instead of
  executing signed-overflow behavior. CMake applies exact idempotent
  replacements, requires exactly two original or two patched corrector blocks,
  writes the fetched header only when its content changes, and fails if the
  pinned targets change. Off-by-default native correctness targets compile the
  normal and COMPRESS_ONLY_K branches in separate executables and drive
  controlled k=31 symbols to the exact range rejection.

The wrapper also validates container extents and supplies bounded callbacks
before calling the codec.
